editionLabel: Brotherwise Games English base-game rules, December 2020
firstPlayerRule: Choose a first player. The rulebook recommends whoever most recently raised a full legion of undead; if nobody has, choose randomly.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from the chosen player.
The undead criterion is a recommendation, not a required way to choose.
